answers.text: "A Creek bar is not a new high." True, and my method does not ask for one. C7: the preferred trend entry is the back-up to the broken Creek. D swing high 345.46 broken, high_20bar 363.95 printed 2026-11-05, close 345.76 back at the Creek, W and D HH/HL, H1 HL: that is the test, not a failure. The 363.95 high caps the first target (C14), not the entry. I would concede on a daily close back under the Creek.
